title: Sigil and Wolf Again
author: Hazel Brightwater
blurb: Silas Vasquez, a debt-bound temple scribe, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. But when a child arrives at the door speaking a language that predates kingdoms, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must unbind a king from the thing wearing his crown before the last dragon-fire gutters out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
